notes: Normalized from raw/masterclass.{json,css,html} + desktop/mobile screenshots + frames s00–s10. Type scale rounded from the site's px ladder (12/14/16/20/24/32/48/64/80); 13.33px and 22px are one-off widget sizes, dropped. `space.scale` is the ≥960px resolution of the responsive `--mc-scale-N` index — steps 1–8 are nearly pinned across breakpoints while 9–12 grow, so the ladder is deliberately non-linear; no clamp()/fluid type anywhere. `shadow` is not a drop-shadow scale: all four recorded box-shadows are INSET rings used as focus/selection outlines — elevation on this dark ground is a surface-lightness step, not a shadow. color.dark is OMITTED: the site never re-themes (`color-scheme: normal`, no prefers-color-scheme rules) — its single native theme IS dark, and the probe's `supportsDark: true` only reflects that toggling the media query changed nothing. #dcff00 and #211d0d are campaign paint from one sub-brand band, present as raw arbitrary gradient values rather than tokens; kept under `roles` and labelled. The 50s figure in the raw durations list is the vertical hero marquee; the horizontal variant reads its duration from `--scroll-duration` (default 40s). `mask-feathered-snap-rail` is filed under scroll_effects as `clip` because the visual change is a mask, not a transform — it is pure CSS with no scroll handler.
